name: find_tests
description: Find test files for a source file: naming conventions + import graph reverse lookup. Index optional (convention fallback). For running found tests, use test_bridge(action="run"). Prefer over manual glob/find for test discovery.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Index optional (convention fallback).

file.description: Source file path relative to workspace_dir (e.g. "src/auth.py")

symbol.description: Optional: narrow to tests referencing a specific symbol
